subject: Extend llama ROI to N consecutive matmul iterations
description: Currently ANDESIM_ROI_MUL_MAT_K marks exactly one matmul (node K). Extend to mark a small consecutive range (K..K+N-1) so the ROI covers multiple iterations, keeping N small (a few) since a full kernel run is too slow on the cycle-accurate leg. Verify with a real hybrid run and report the cycle count for the range.
activeForm: Extending llama ROI to N consecutive matmul iterations
